name: cdl-labelflash
description: CDL-云签速印：标签扫码重打
author: heisir2014 <heisir21@163.com>

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p src/renderer/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p e2e/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p relay/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p relay/web/tsconfig.json
scripts.test:e2e: electron-vite build && bun run verify:bundle && playwright test
scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun test
scripts.dist:win: electron-vite build && bun run verify:bundle && bun scripts/installer/build-installer.ts --publish never
scripts.release:win: electron-vite build && bun run verify:bundle && bun scripts/installer/build-installer.ts --publish always
